verdicts.reason: Both pull the FIZZBANG! logo pill out of the white card and set it oversized on top of the busy dark circle and yellow shape, so it collides with the art and competes with the headline. Both also break the headline badly, leaving 'a can' as a short second line. A keeps the CTA centred under the headline, but its card runs off the top edge and sits awkwardly against the right side. B's card fits better, but its CTA is pushed to the left edge of the card and out of line with the centred headline, which looks less intentional. Overall A is slightly better.
